::: notes

Preserve the booklet prompt exactly. Complete the working in OneNote and use each reveal only after students have attempted it. Amplitude 1/2, midline y=1, maximum 3/2, minimum 1/2. T=π; quarter-period step π/4. One cycle: (0,1),(π/4,3/2),(π/2,1),(3π/4,1/2),(π,1). Repeat to 2π, giving two cycles and final point (2π,1). Domain [0,2π], range [1/2,3/2], y-intercept 1 and no x-intercepts. The curve begins by increasing. Reset returns to unlabelled construction axes without revealing answers. Allow about 8 minutes.

:::
